title: Event request
description: Body of POST /v1/events. `event_id` is client-generated and is the deduplication key; replaying the same event is a safe no-op (ADR-0012).

decision_id.description: The decision this event is a consequence of. Omit or set null for site-wide signals that no placement claimed.

type.description: Event type. 'impression', 'click', 'lead' and 'purchase' are reserved with fixed meaning; any other value is a tenant-defined type that must be declared in tenant configuration.

occurred_at.description: Client clock. Untrusted: stored as reported, never used in place of the server's received_at. Rejected when more than 5 minutes in the future or more than 7 days in the past.

properties.description: Optional tenant-defined payload. Must not contain personal data. Total serialized size is limited to 4 KiB by the API.
